item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】(Album request) Brooke Allison - 2001
item.description:
Hi! I’m looking for help finding this album, Brooke Allison. It was recorded by a young artist back in 2001, but about a month ago it was removed from all streaming platforms and is no longer available digitally anywhere.

https://open.spotify.com/intl-it/album/2dkxkhEtPRN4tMUZRGXvSN (the spotify album result grayed out)

Sadly, she was a very Y2K-style pop girl with a really tragic story, she is currently in a coma, and her music means a lot to people who followed her work. As far as I know, the video for the lead single and parts of the album are still on YouTube, but they’re in a lossy format. That means the only way to hear the album in lossless quality now would be if someone still has the original CD.

If anyone here happens to own the CD, would you be willing to rip it in a lossless format and share it? It would really help preserve something important that’s otherwise been lost.

Thank you so much in advance for any help.
item.author: mary_delprete04
